Cloud Secure is a cloud drive protection application for android that will secure your cloud drive accounts on your device. Prevent prying eyes from peeping into your cloud storage account which holds all your valued documents, photos, videos and important or confidential files and archives.
Supported Cloud Drives

🔒Google Drive
🔒One Drive
🔒Box
🔒DropBox

Features

Lock Google Drive, Box, One Drive or DropBox with a single click
Syncing is active while your cloud is locked
Security Methods : Password, PIN or Pattern
Panic Switch
Stealth Mode
Hack Attempts Monitoring
Password Pin or Pattern recovery option.
